import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
credit_fraud = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')
credit_fraud.columns = ['amount', 'is_fraud', 'transaction_type', 'hour_of_day']

# Create a bar plot to show the distribution of fraud transactions by hour of day
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='hour_of_day', hue='is_fraud', data=credit_fraud, ax=ax)
ax.set_title('Distribution of Fraud Transactions by Hour of Day')
ax.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax.set_ylabel('Count')
ax.legend(title='Fraud Status')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
